codeReview.summary: The theme overhaul covers most Cellar Ledger tokens, but two blocking gaps remain: the requested note/observation category token was not updated to the specified blue palette, and the dark M3 theme still resolves body text from `surface[900]` (#F0F2F0) instead of the required `#E8E4DE` bark-charcoal text token.

issues.description: The feature required note colors `#5C6D91` (light) and `#7A8DAA` (dark), but the theme still exposes the legacy `observation` token at `#738c7a` / `#8a9a8e` and never defines a `note` token. Existing note/observation flows still resolve through `src/styles/utils.ts:103` to `colors.observation[500]`, so note-related UI cannot pick up the specified Cellar Ledger blue tokens.

The dark M3 theme does not use the requested bark-charcoal text color. `createM3Theme()` sets `onBackground` and `onSurface` from `themeColors.surface[900]` (see also line 389), which resolves to `#F0F2F0` in dark mode, while the feature description requires dark text to be `#E8E4DE`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `ui-worker` skill says `npm test -- --passWithNoTests` must exit 0, but this worker's transcript shows the test command failed and the handoff still marked `skillFeedback.followedProcedure=true` and `validatorsPassed=true`. The skill or mission guidance should clarify how to report pre-existing validator failures instead of treating them as a successful run.
